Answer: C
Reason: Comparing the two chest X-rays, the 2007 image demonstrates increased pleural thickening and apical fibrotic changes compared to the 2003 baseline. In patients with chronic fibrotic sarcoidosis, this progression creates cavities that are prone to colonization by Aspergillus species, leading to the development of an aspergillus mycetoma (fungus ball).
